RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the November 27, 2002/Agrahayana 6, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
37
Implementation of rural development
schemes
*121.SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether some State Governments are
facing problem of financing the centrally
sponsored schemes;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how Government propose to solve
the problem?
Vishnuprayag and Srinagar hydro-
power projects
†*122. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agreements
for Vishnuprayag and Srinagar hydro-
power projects of Uttaranchal are proposed
to be signed afresh;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Uttar Pradesh's demand for
12 per cent free power is the main hurdle in
the implementation of these projects; and
(d) if so, the details of action Government
propose to take to resolve the said hurdle?
Per capita consumption of electricity
†*123. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of State-wise per capita
consumption of electricity in the country;
(b) the details of consumption of
electricity in urban and rural areas of various
States of the country; and
(c) how these compare with international
data in this regard?
Coal deposits in States
†*124. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of coal deposits in each
State;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

38
WIN2\SESSION\3827RS 38
(b) the average annual mining in each
State;
(c) whether there is any possibility of
more coal deposits being available;  and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
New Power Tariff policy
*125.DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
a new power tariff policy;
(b) if so, whether Government have
received comments from an independent
credit rating agency and views of all
stakeholders; and
(c) if so, by when will the new policy be
announced and the new tariff  likely to come
in force?
Court of Inquiry into Jaguar crash at
Ambala
*126. SHRI SURESH KALMADI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether Government have ordered
a Court of Inquiry into the Jaguar crash at
Ambala Cantonment on 5th November,
2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and its
findings;
(c) the steps being taken to provide
compensation to the victims of the crash;
(d) how many Jaguar aircrafts were
involved in accidents during the last two
years; and
(e) whether Government propose to
improve the safety measures at Ambala
Cantonment Air base, if so, the details
thereof?
Production of hank-yarn
†*127. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is mandatory for the yarn
manufacturing units to produce 50 per cent
hank-yarn;
(b)  if so, the yarn production capacity in
the country during the years 2000-2001 and
2001-2002 and the actual production made
during the said years; and
(c)  the estimated requirement of hank-
yarn in the country during the aforesaid
years?
Exports of readymade garments and
handicrafts
*128. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
sharp dip in exports of readymade garments
and handicrafts;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and
measures proposed for boosting exports;
and
(c)  the details of relief provided to
affected small exporters of garments and
handicrafts?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
WIN2\SESSION\3827RS 39
Investment requirements of N.T.P.C.
*129.SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has directed
National Thermal Power Corporation and
other corporations to firm up plans to tap
capital market to meet their investment
requirements in the coming years;
(b)  if so, whether this is in view of
massive capacity addition programme being
planned by Power Ministry;
(c)  if so, to what extent these
corporations have agreed to the directive of
the Ministry; and
(d) to what extent they have been
successful in meeting the investment
requirements for developing power?
Accidents involving IAF aircrafts
*130. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a)  the number of accidents involving
the IAF aircrafts since 1996;
(b)  the details of reasons which caused
the accidents in each of the cases;
(c)  whether it is a fact that majority of
these accidents were caused due to human
errors;
(d) if so, whether it is the result of lack
of proper training facilities; and
(e) if so, the measures proposed, if any,
to improve the situation?
Functioning of terror schools in
Pakistan
*131. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the news-item captioned "Pak terror school
still functioning" which appeared in The
Hindustan Times on 15th October, 2002;
(b)  whether the role of ISI in aiding
cross border terrorism has now been
reoriented and their control over the Pak
terror schools/camps grown stronger; and
(c)  if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto?
Recruitment of officers in the Air Force
*132. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air Force is
thinking of using regional languages in tests
for recruiting airmen and other officers to
get the best talent;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c)  the total number of airmen and
officers' posts lying vacant, zone-wise?
Implementation of schemes in NER
*133. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) the scheme-wise details of outlays
for NER in the Tenth Five Year Plan,
including the ones by the Central Silk Board,
under 10 per cent budgetary provisions;
(b)  the implementation status of ongoing
schemes in the region and when they are
targeted to be completed; and

40
WIN2\SESSION\3827RS 40
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c)  the details of State-wise list of
proposals received from NGOs for
implementation of programmes of the
Ministry in NER indicating name of the
NGO, date of receipt and date of sanction
of the proposals during the current financial
year?
Revival of Textile Industry
*134. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether Government are aware that
the textile industry is facing its worst slump
since independence;
(b) whether the Central Government
intend to introduce measures to revive the
textile industry both in terms of export and
internal consumption; and
(c)  if so, the actions Government
propose to take to extend aid and revenue
support to promising textile houses?
Pull back of troops
*135. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a reciprocal
move on the part of the Pakistan
Government to the Indian decision to pull
back its troops from combat position;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c)  the steps taken to ensure that the pull
back does not compromise the defence and
security needs of the country?
Per unit cost of electricity
*136. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) what is the per unit cost of electricity,
State-wise, Union Territory-wise and sector-
wise;
(b)  the cost of electricity per unit in the
developing countries and developed
countries; and
(c)  the reasons for variations?
Indo-Russian joint venture for
manufacture of fighter jets
†*137. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any agreement, to set up a
joint venture for manufacturing high quality
fighter jets, has been signed between Indian
and Russian Governments;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the agreement will come
into effect?
Custodial deaths
*138.DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Human Rights
Commission has recorded 1305 reports of
custodial deaths between April, 2001 and
March, 2002;
(b)  if so, whether there has been an
increase in case of deaths in both judicial
and police custody compared to the previous
year;
(c)  if so, the States where higher
custodial deaths have taken place; and

41
WIN2\SESSION\3827RS 41
(d) what are the steps being taken in this
regard?
Funds granted to
DRDAs in NER
*139. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds granted under
Centre-State share to District Rural
Development Agency in North Eastern
Region during the last three years; and
(b)  the details of amount released so far
and actually utilised in the region?
Replacement of MIG-21 aircrafts
*140. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is fact that the performance
of MIG-21 aircrafts has been causing
concern to the Government due to many
mishaps;
(b)  if so, the details of alternative options
being considered to replace MIG-21 aircraft;
(c)  whether any efforts are being made
to develop and manufacture indigenously,
multi-role fighter jets superior to Mirage
and MIG-29 aircrafts; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
NEW D ELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,

Corrupt practices by CIL officials
765. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL  AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an official of
Coal India Limited complained to Chief
Vigilance Commissioner regarding corrupt
practices indulged by one General Manager,
Personnel of CIL;
(b) whether the complainant has been
transferred subsequently;
(c) the reasons for such transfer;
(d) whether Government have received
any representation against this transfer;
and
(e) if so, the response of Government on
the representation?
Discovery of diamond mines in Orissa
766. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
discovered new diamond mines in the State
of Orissa;
(b) if so, the approximate areas in which
diamond mines are located;
(c) the steps taken for the proper
exploitation of those diamond mines; and
(d) the details thereof?
Performance of NALCO
767. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the public sector
undertaking, National Aluminium Company
(NALCO) has been earning profit;
(b) if so, since when and the
performance of NALCO during last three
years;
(c) whether Government have a
proposal for the expansion of NALCO;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the various steps taken therefor?
Misuse of Official telephone
768. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that General
Manager, Personnel, Coal India Ltd. was
found misusing his Official telephones for
making international indecent calls;

171
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 171
(b) if so, the details thereof and amount
involved in misuse;
(c) whether Coal India Ltd. enquired into
the matter; and
(d) if so, the action taken against the
concerned official?
Private investment in coal
sector
769. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the policy regarding private
investment in the coal sector;
(b) what has been the response of the
private sector; and
(c) the details of steps taken by
Government for mining of underground
mines with the assistance of private sector?
Illegal coal mining
770. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have found
large scale illegal coal mining in the
command areas of the Central Coalfields
Limited;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Coal Mines Nationalisation
Act would be amended suitably to curb such
illegal practices;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the officials of CCI have
been involved in such illegal mining; and
(f) if so, action Government propose to
take in this regard?
Raising of Tiger force by IAF
771. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is true that the Indian Air
Force is seriously thinking of raising a force
with new inductions and selective upgrades
to supplement its air detection system;
(b) if so, the details of such expansion;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Air
Force is proposing to raise "Tiger Force" to
guard airports and other expensive and
important areas of the country; and
(d) if so, by when?
Exit Policy for officers of armed
forces
772. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
is working out on Exit Policy for the officers
of the Army, Air Force and Navy to bring
down the average age of commanding
officers and brigade commands;
(b) if so, would it be on the lines of the
VRS offered in the PSUs;
(c) whether the proposed exercise is a
part of the cadre review or cadre restructuring
to improve the functional command; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

172
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 172
Strengthening the LoC
773. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been made to
find out that instead of mobilization of
Defence Forces from our Borders, involving
a maintenance expenditure of 7,000 crores
whether the desired purpose would have
been served by only strengthening the LoC,
which would have involved much less
mobilization and appreciably less
maintenance expenditure; and
(b) if so, what are the details thereof?
Gains accrued from mobilization of
armed forces
774. DR. MANMOHAN SINGH:
SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the gains which accrued to the country
from mobilization of armed forces since the
beginning of the current year; and
(b) the additional expenditure incurred
on this account in 2001-2002 and likely extra
expenditure during 2002-2003?
Pull out of army from Indo-Pak
Border
775. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the compelling reasons which led to
the pull out of the army from the Indo-Pak
Border;
(b) whether the decision was taken at the
political level without adequate and
meaningful consultation with the concerned
defence authorities; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Appointment of Generals in Indian
Army
776. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Army has requested the Government to
appoint 432 Generals; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and
Government's reaction thereto?
Purchase of L-159 aircraft
777. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is true that Government
has decided to purchase L-159 aircraft; and
(b) if so, what are the reasons to select
L-159 aircraft over Hawks?
Representation from residents of
border areas for withdrawal of
armed forces
778. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any representation from the residents of
border areas for the withdrawal of the army
from the border areas due to prevailing
drought conditions in Rajasthan and Punjab;
(b) whether it is a fact that no
compensation has been paid for the large
number of cattle killed by landmines, for
the destruction of crops and for
displacement of rural labourers of that areas;

173
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 173
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the details of other demands
made thereof; and
(d) the action taken by Government in
the matter?
CAG criticism on purchases made
during Kargil war
779. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CAG in its
latest report has criticised Government with
regard to the purchase of anti-aircraft
missiles and bombs during the Kargil war
'Operation Vijay'; and
(b) if so, Governments' reaction thereto?
India-France talks on defence
780. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
France had a talk in Paris recently for
transfer of technology for manufacture of
Mirage 2000;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the other areas of understanding
reached with France during the discussion?
Compensation to soldiers killed during
Kargil war
†781. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of soldiers killed during
the Kargil war;
(b) the number of soldiers killed since
the end of Kargil war till date;
(c) whether Government have given full
compensation to the next of kin of those
killed during the said period; and
(d) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the list?
Project 75 of Nav Submarine Design
Bureau
782. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Naval Submarine Design
Bureau has launched its Project 75; and
(b) if so, the details of its target alongwith
the estimated expenses per unit and the
timeframe set for its completion?
Defence cooperation with Laos
783. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to step up defence cooperation with
Laos; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
IL-38 aircraft collision in Goa
784. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that two Russian
Ilyushin-38 maritime reconnaissance aircraft
collided in mid air during an air show killing
16 people near INS Hansa Naval Airbase in
Goa;
(b) if so, the details of the incident;
(c) whether any enquiry has been
ordered to look into the whole incident; and

174
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 174
(d) if so, whether the Committee has
submitted its report and the results of the
report?
Phasing out of MIGs
785. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than 100
MIG-21s fighter jets have crashed so far
due to various factors;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have conducted
inquiry into each air crash and if so, what
are the broad details of inquiry reports of
each air craft crash; and
(d) whether Government propose to
phase out these aircrafts and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Compensation to families of deceased
IL-38 plane crash victims
786. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the families of the victims of
defence personnel who died in an IL-38
Naval plane crash over Goa have made a
representation to the Government to declare
the deaths 'Under active duty';
(b) whether Government had earlier
declared such deaths as in harness; and
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider the representation of the deceased's
kith and kin and offer them adequate
compensation and privileges admissible
under 'Active duty' category?
Increase in MIG crashes
787. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the incidents of MIG 21
crashes have been increasing during the
current year in comparison to the last five
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether two MIG 21 crashes have
taken place in the month of September, 2002,
after getting clearance to fly;
(d) if so, the reasons of such crashes;
and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
retire MIG 21 and bring confidence about
safety of the planes?
MIG-21 planes with IAF
788. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of MIG-21 planes with
IAF;
(b) the number of MIGs crashed between
2000-2002;
(c) whether accident rate was more; and
(d) whether the causes of the accidents
have been analysed?
Purchase of inferior spares/equipments
for MIG-21
789. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India
purchased second hand (reconditioned)
engines, spares and other equipments of
MIG-21;

175
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 175
(b)  whether MIG spares came under
cloud as two planes crashed in a single day
in September, 2002; and
(c)  if not, whether the cause of the crash
probed and analysed by the Hindustan
Aeronautics Ltd. officials?
Indo-France joint exercises
790. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that France will
conduct combat exercises with the Indian
Air Force in Gwalior next year;
(b)  if so, the number of exercises likely
to be performed;
(c)  whether it is also a fact that the Indian
Air Force has recently been trained by the
Air Forces of some other countries; and
(d) if so, what are the names of such
countries?
Benefits of Indo-US joint military
exercises
791. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
Indo-US military exercises have taken place
during the last one year;
(b)  if so, the details thereof and the
benefits derived by our defence forces
therefrom;
(c)  whether these exercises also covered
combating nuclear war;
(d) whether such joint exercises have
also been carried out recently with Pakistan;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Setting up new coast guard stations
792. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to set up 10 new coast guard
stations along different coasts of the country
to check the rising smuggling activity and
to facilitate greater maritime operations;
(b)  if so, the details of the proposal; and
(c)  whether the Ministry has got the
approval from the Ministry of Finance?
Induction of IL-78 aircraft
793. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) by when the Indian Air Force will
induct IL-78 aircraft;
(b)  by when the Air Force is going to
get Mirage 2000 fighters fitted with air-to-
air refuelling capability; and
(c) what are the obstacles in inducting
the above aircrafts into the Indian Air Force?
Propriety of decorating tainted
officer
794. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air Marshal
M.S. Sekhon was presented the Param
Vishisht Seva Medal;
(b)  whether it is also true that Shri
Sekhon was made to retire prematurely after
the revelation of his seeking political help
for his career promotion;
(c)  if so, whether there is any impropriety
in decorating such tainted officers with such
prestigious awards; and
(d) comment of Government thereon?

176
WIN2\SESSION\3829RS 176
Proposal for amending Human Rights
Act
795. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
proposals for amending Human Rights Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
All Women Police Stations
796. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the States in which All-women Police
Stations have been opened with nature of
cases entrusted to them, especially relating
to women; and
(b) what is feedback of performance of
All-women Police Station opened in
Bhubaneswar in Orissa?
Atrocities against women
†797. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN
 AHMED KHAN (DURRU):
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the comprehensive details of the
atrocities committed against women in
various States of the country during the last
three years, State-wise/year-wise/crime-
wise; and
(b) the effective steps taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to check the
incidents of atrocities committed against
women?
Financial rules of Ladakh Council
798. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that though the
Ladakh Council was set up long back in the
year 1975, the financial rules of the Council
